title: 6 Things a Godly Man Stops Excusing as "Just How I Am"
caption:
Scripture doesn't grade on personality.

The temper, the midnight scroll, the silence when a brother needs a text back, the comparison you call competitiveness, the avoidance you call being laid back, the joke that always lands on someone. Ephesians doesn't say manage the old self. It says put it off, not personality-test it.

"Just how I am" was never a category Scripture recognized.
